edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the initial _owner through __Ownable_init during initialize
initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE and PAUSER_ROLE to _msgSender()
name parameter flows into initialize
symbol parameter flows into initialize
initialize writes _name through __ERC20_init_unchained
initialize writes _symbol through __ERC20_init_unchained
_authorizeUpgrade is wrapped by the onlyOwner modifier
onlyOwner compares owner() against _msgSender()
upgradeTo calls _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade
upgradeToAndCall calls _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade
newImplementation parameter reaches the access-controlled _authorizeUpgrade
upgradeTo delegates the upgrade to _upgradeToAndCallSecure
upgradeToAndCall delegates the upgrade to _upgradeToAndCallSecure
_upgradeToAndCallSecure delegatecalls into the new implementation for setup and rollback test
rollback testing flag is toggled around the delegatecall during _upgradeToAndCallSecure
_functionDelegateCall performs a low-level delegatecall to the new implementation
delegatecall target derives from the caller-supplied newImplementation address
mint checks hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, _msgSender()) before minting
mint calls _mint after the role check
to parameter is forwarded to _mint
amount parameter is forwarded to _mint
pause checks hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, _msgSender())
unpause checks hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, _msgSender())
pause sets _paused to true
unpause sets _paused to false
transfer calls _transfer with _msgSender()
transferFrom calls _transfer
recipient parameter reaches _transfer through transfer
sender parameter reaches _transfer through transferFrom
amount parameter reaches the internal _transfer
_transfer updates the _balances mapping for sender and recipient
senderBalance local is read from _balances inside _transfer
senderBalance derives directly from the _balances mapping
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook which is overridable by derived contracts
_beforeTokenTransfer reads _paused to block transfers while paused
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply, an arithmetic supply update
_mint credits the recipient entry in _balances
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_burn subtracts amount from _totalSupply, an arithmetic supply update
_burn debits the account entry in _balances
accountBalance local is read from _balances inside _burn
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
burn calls _burn with _msgSender()
burnFrom calls _burn for the target account
account parameter is burned in burnFrom
burnFrom computes currentAllowance from allowance(account, _msgSender())
burnFrom performs an unchecked currentAllowance - amount subtraction before _approve
currentAllowance is sourced from the _allowances mapping
transferFrom reads currentAllowance from _allowances[sender][_msgSender()]
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
approve calls _approve with _msgSender() as owner
spender parameter controls the approved address
grantRole uses onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) which invokes _checkRole
_checkRole verifies that _msgSender() holds the required role
grantRole calls _grantRole after authorization
revokeRole calls _revokeRole after authorization
_grantRole sets the member flag inside _roles
_grantRole adds the account to the _roleMembers enumerable set
_revokeRole clears the member flag inside _roles
_revokeRole removes the account from the _roleMembers enumerable set
_msgSender() address is tracked as a role member during initialization
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
newOwner parameter becomes the new owner
transferOwnership calls _transferOwnership
_transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable
oldOwner local is read from the _owner state variable
_add calls _contains before inserting to avoid duplicates
value parameter is inserted into the underlying set array
_remove computes lastIndex = set._values.length - 1 with unchecked index arithmetic
toDeleteIndex = valueIndex - 1 unchecked index computation in _remove
_remove caches lastvalue from _values before the swap
sendValue forwards all gas to recipient via a low-level call
functionCallWithValue forwards all gas and value via a low-level call
the low-level call target is the untrusted recipient address
